edc-baidu-3.webp.zh: 机场的白色控制塔台：方形塔身顶部是玻璃指挥室，塔下停着车辆与一架直升机。
edc-baidu-3.webp.en: The airport's white control tower — a glazed cab on a square shaft, vehicles and a helicopter at its base.

edc-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 深蓝色暮色中，一座带弧形雨棚的白色机库亮着灯，玻璃幕墙上的“Henriksen”字样清晰可见。
edc-chatgpt-01.webp.en: In deep blue dusk, a white hangar with a sweeping curved canopy glows with lights, its glass facade lettered Henriksen above the apron.

edc-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 暮色里，白色公务机停在弧形雨棚下，加油车贴着机身作业，地面摆着几只橙色锥筒。
edc-chatgpt-02.webp.en: At dusk a white business jet waits beneath the curved canopy while a fuel truck works alongside it, with orange cones marking the concrete apron.

edc-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 宽敞的旅客休息厅铺着浅色木地板，落地窗外是停机坪，中央陈列着一台巨大的喷气发动机。
edc-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A spacious lounge with pale wood floors and stone pillars looks out through tall windows onto the apron, a large jet engine displayed on a stand in the middle.

edc-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 前台处两名工作人员隔着柜台递钥匙，显示器上是“Austin Executive”的标志。
edc-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Behind the front desk two staff members pass a set of keys across the counter, with the Austin Executive logo shown on the monitor beside them.

edc-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 蓝天下，白色机库外墙写着“Austin Executive”字样，黄色防撞柱沿水泥路面排开。
edc-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Under a clear blue sky, a huge white hangar carries the words Austin Executive Airport, with yellow bollards lining the empty concrete road in front.

edc-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 夜色中的机库灯火通明，几架小型单发飞机与一架双发飞机并排停放在光洁的地板上。
edc-chatgpt-06.webp.en: The hangar is brightly lit after dark, with several small single-engine aircraft and one twin-engine plane parked side by side on the polished floor.

edc-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 夜里，机库前的弧形雨棚亮着一排灯，白色墙面与水泥停机坪在暗处泛着微光。
edc-chatgpt-07.webp.en: At night the curved canopy outside the hangar glows with a row of lamps, lighting white walls and a wide sweep of concrete apron.
